hooks.text: 神秘方块持续喷出资源，石头村民分别负责击打、捡币与维持部落运转
hooks.excerpt: At the center of the island stands a mysterious cube that constantly spits out resources. Before long, an entire stone tribe begins revolving around it in a frenzy. Some villagers punch the cube. Others run around collecting the coins and resources scattered everywhere. And your job is to keep the whole tribe growing.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 方块升级会让资源循环逐渐失稳，必须持续调整技能、职业与成长路径保持效率
hooks.excerpt: As the cube levels up, the resource cycle gradually becomes unstable. You’ll need to continuously adjust skills, professions, and growth paths to keep the entire system running efficiently.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 职业与技能构筑叠加天赋、神殿祝福和季节挑战，最终形成满屏资源爆发
hooks.excerpt: The Stone Tribe As the game progresses, you’ll gradually unlock: More professions and skill builds Talent combinations and temple blessings Seasonal island challenges and growth rewards Increasingly absurd numbers and screen-filling effects
